profile.headline: Data platform leader building dependable lineage systems
profile.about: I build data platforms and turn complex system landscapes into reliable, explainable products.

experiences.summary: I led a 12-person data platform team and built a lineage platform supporting more than 80 upstream systems.

projects.name: data-lineage-toolkit
projects.summary: Open lineage platform for dependable data operations.

achievements.statement: Cut lineage onboarding time from six weeks to one week
achievements.problem: Upstream metadata was inconsistent and column-level lineage was unreliable
achievements.constraint: The legacy catalog could not be replaced within the annual planning window
achievements.decision: We adopted an incremental contract registry instead of a full catalog migration
achievements.action: I implemented the ingestion contract registry and the lineage graph service
achievements.result: New upstream systems reached trusted lineage in under one week
achievements.metric: Onboarding time reduced from six weeks to one week

achievements.statement: I led a 12-person data platform team and built a lineage platform supporting more than 80 upstream systems.
Scaled the lineage platform to 80 upstream systems
achievements.problem: Lineage coverage stopped at batch ingestion and missed stream sources
achievements.constraint: The platform had a two-person maintenance budget
achievements.decision: We standardized source onboarding on declarative contracts
achievements.action: I rolled out the contract template to service teams and automated ownership checks
achievements.result: 80 upstream systems onboarded with owned metadata
